author: Elizabeth Tabler
description:
“Fuck you, I won’t do what you tell me.” Rage Against the Machine shouted it. John Twelve Hawks makes a quieter, no less pointed statement to his readers. His work is full of regular people drowning in technology, cemented into systems that treat human lives like rounding errors and data. He writes stories like questions […]
